description: List every component in the project design system with a one-line description, the native element it renders, its variant values, its parts and its import. Icons (components that render an <svg>) are named on one line per import, or per folder for icons with a module each, five or more to a line. Call this before writing UI in this project. `query`, `kind` and `limit` narrow a long list. At a monorepo root, pass `path` for the project of the file you are editing; without it, every project is listed, each component with its package.

kind.description: "icon": only the components that render an <svg>, one by one. "component": all the others.

limit.description: Most components to list one by one.

path.description: In a monorepo served from its root: the file you are editing, or a project folder, relative to the root, to answer from that project. Without it, every project is listed together. Ignored in a single project. When the server was started outside your project, pass the file as an absolute path: the project is found from it.

query.description: Only components with this text in their name, their parts' names or their description.

name: list_components

components.description: The components listed one by one, after `query`, `kind` and `limit`.

package.description: At a workspace root: the package its source belongs to, e.g. "@acme/ui".

projects.description: At a workspace root: the folders of the projects that use it.

icons.description: Without `kind`: icons, the components that render an <svg>, by name, five or more per module, or per folder for icons with a module each.

from.description: The module they are imported from, or, with `modules`, the folder of their modules.

modules.description: For icons with a module each: each one's module, in the order of `names`.

package.description: At a workspace root: the package its source belongs to, e.g. "@acme/ui".

title: List design-system components
